title: Welcome
narration: Welcome. This experience has been created to help you understand how your banking support will continue after your local branch closure.
You are in control throughout this experience. You can pause, repeat, go back or ask for a colleague to help at any time.
Before we begin, I will help you choose the settings that make this experience most comfortable for you.

title: Choose your support options
narration: Please choose any support options that would make this experience easier for you.
You can select more than one option.
If you would prefer a colleague to help you, please select colleague-assisted mode.

title: A few short questions
narration: Before I show the banking alternatives, I would like to ask a few short questions.
These questions help us understand whether this experience improves your confidence.
There are no right or wrong answers.

scales.prompt: How concerned do you feel about your local branch closing?
How confident are you that you know where to go for banking after the branch closes?
How confident are you using mobile banking?

title: Is there anything you are worried about?
narration: Before we continue, would you like to share any concerns or reactions about the branch closure?
You can select from the options, or skip this step.

choices.label: I am worried about travelling further
I do not feel confident using mobile banking
I need help from a person
I need privacy for my banking
I am not sure what services are available elsewhere

title: Thank you for telling me
narration: I will now shape the experience around this need.
You can change or add concerns later.

responses.travel: Thank you for sharing that. I will prioritise nearby options, distance, travel choices and whether the place offers the service you need.
responses.cash: Thank you. I will show cash access options first, including cash machines, Banking Hubs, Post Offices and other cash services where available.
responses.digital: Thank you. Later in this experience, I will show a safe practice version of mobile banking. No real account details or real money will be used.
responses.human: Thank you. I will make sure the journey shows where you can speak to a person, including branch colleagues, Community Bankers and support lines.
responses.accessibility: Thank you. I will keep accessibility support visible throughout the journey, including seating, subtitles, private space, low-motion mode and colleague assistance.
responses.privacy: Thank you. I will show where private conversations may be available, and I will avoid showing sensitive details on shared screens.
responses.unsure: Thank you. I will show what each nearby option can and cannot do, so you know before you travel.

title: We can pause here
narration: We can pause here.
You do not need to continue right now.
A colleague can support you if you would like.
You may take a seat, have some water and continue only when you are ready.

title: The main counter
narration: This is the main counter.
You can come here for everyday banking support.
For example, you may ask about cash withdrawal, cash deposit, cheque deposit or balance enquiry.
If you are unsure what to ask, you can simply say: I need help with my banking today.
